stable_resolution.rule: Stable lower bounds express the supported compatibility floor; the lock records the exact development and release-candidate resolution. They must be reported and validated separately.
stable_resolution.strict_frontier_target: Report minimum-supported, locked, latest-compatible, latest-overall, upper-bound blocker, prerelease, and support-window status separately; fail only on a declared policy violation.
stable_resolution.release_rule: Release artifacts use the committed frozen lock and never resolve an unreviewed preview dependency.

requirements: numerical and serialization evidence where applicable

lanes.isolation: separate generated preview lock and non-blocking workflow; never mutate uv.lock
required_gates: full candidate matrix before bound change

lanes.isolation: allow-failure observation jobs with no release artifacts
candidates: Rust nightly diagnostics without release artifacts
required_gates: upstream runtime release or explicit beta policy
full candidate matrix before support claim

lanes.isolation: measured feature branch and non-authoritative preview workflow
candidates: pytest-xdist worksteal and bounded worker hook
Scalene 2.3 targeted CPU and memory profiles
openpyxl as an explicit Excel test extra

lanes.isolation: existing experimental extra and explicit experimental namespace

correctness: no accepted numerical drift outside declared tolerance
interchange: nullable, categorical, timezone, copy, and ownership behavior
security_and_licence: provenance for binaries and build tools
performance: no material regression unless explicitly justified
documentation: preview label removed only at promotion

cpu_fallback_policy.rule: Accelerator, free-threaded, distributed, compiled-serialization, and preview analytical paths must retain a supported stable CPU path with equivalent declared semantics.
cpu_fallback_policy.failure_behavior: Unavailable preview acceleration returns a documented capability or backend error and must not silently change estimator semantics.

promotion_receipt.authority: Repository evidence may recommend a decision; stable promotion requires the full candidate gate and maintainer-owned merge boundary.

triggers: material unapproved performance or memory regression
actions: restore the last known-good stable bound and lock
disable the preview lane or feature flag
record the trigger and affected artifacts
publish no release from the failed candidate
rollback_policy.data_compatibility: A rollback may not strand user data; retain readers or provide a versioned migration for any candidate-written format before promotion.
rollback_policy.preview_failure: A failing observation lane records evidence and remains non-blocking unless it reveals a vulnerability or regression in the stable resolution.

prohibited_shortcuts: Changing stable upper bounds based only on successful resolution or import.
Treating latest-overall as the required minimum supported version.
Using preview dependencies in release artifacts before promotion.
Claiming accelerator support without an exercised CPU fallback.
Accepting benchmark improvement with changed numerical or serialization semantics.
Allowing a non-blocking preview job to hide a stable-lane failure.
